scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @nestidp/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "pnpm --filter @nestidp/shared exec tsc -w -p tsconfig.json --preserveWatchOutput" "pnpm --filter @nestidp/api dev" "pnpm --filter @nestidp/web dev"
scripts.dev:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile dev up --build
scripts.dev:docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile dev down
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @nestidp/shared build && pnpm --filter @nestidp/web build && pnpm --filter @nestidp/api build
